verification.note: Refresh of 18 Oct 2026 under the rule that level A needs the instrument's own text or an official register. The only stored source is IDFPR's press release of 4 Aug 2025 (idfpr.illinois.gov PDF, stored 11 Oct 2026, unchanged on 18 Oct 2026), an announcement, so the title, date and status count as alt-official and the record is level B. The release confirms the title, that Governor Pritzker signed the Act 'on Friday' before the Monday release (1 Aug 2025), that it passed both chambers unanimously and took effect on signature, the prohibition and the permitted administrative and supplementary uses, IDFPR's power to investigate and the fine of up to $10,000. The Act's text (Public Act 104-0054, a number taken from a web search) and the bill status page on ilga.gov were requested in this run and could not be stored: the connection to ilga.gov failed again, as in earlier runs. The Public Act number and the General Assembly in official_identifier are therefore not in a stored source.

title.quote: The Wellness and Oversight for Psychological Resources Act prohibits anyone from using AI to provide mental health and therapeutic decision-making

issuing_body.quote: Governor JB Pritzker signed legislation on Friday that protects patients by limiting the use of artificial intelligence (AI) in therapy and psychotherapy services.
Act was unanimously passed in each chamber of the Illinois General Assembly

judgment.status_reasoning: The release says the Act 'goes into effect immediately with Governor Pritzker’s signature', and the signature was on Friday 1 Aug 2025 (the release is dated Monday 4 Aug 2025). No stored file shows an amendment or repeal. 'In force' stands.
judgment.date_reasoning: The release is dated 4 August 2025 and says the Governor signed 'on Friday', which is 1 August 2025. The quote is the signing sentence; the release date itself is the announcement, not the signature. Both dates rest on the announcement: level B.
judgment.scope_reasoning: AI-specific state law prohibiting AI therapy; in scope with no note.
